# Spell FX assets

These GLB files are individual models by Quaternius from Poly Pizza: [Fireball](https://poly.pizza/m/wMkC4EmH8P), [Lightning Hands](https://poly.pizza/m/39uv7ux42v), [Magic Rock](https://poly.pizza/m/K6ROPQj7PX), [Earth Bending](https://poly.pizza/m/Y1HObDkTqk), [Water Element](https://poly.pizza/m/xcLhwyoNvC), [Ice Block](https://poly.pizza/m/dEY0gPZNzG), [Fire Grenade](https://poly.pizza/m/XUmfh7lPiP), [Smoke](https://poly.pizza/m/RReLSfPo1Q), and [Fire Hands](https://poly.pizza/m/jzRNyV49bm). The source pages list them as Public Domain/CC0.
